To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

physical education curriculum should be selected according to the characteristics of students’ physical and mental development,and connected with their life experiences and actual circum-stances by following the principles of combining fitness nature with cul-tural nature,selectivity and effectiveness,national characteristics and world characteristics.

physical education curriculum reform should be based on the principles of selectivity, effectiveness, national characteristics with world characteristics, and combining fitness nature with culture nature; the key point of curriculum reform is to develop and use curriculum resources; physical education teaching contents and methods should be selected according to student’s physical and psychological development; the key to develop curriculum resources is teachers.

the curriculum should be designed to meet the students’ physical and mental development needs, and the teaching materials that can facilitate students’ physical and emotional development and satisfy their interests and love should be created.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of physical education teaching contents,learning methods and curriculum resources,and the development of teaching methods and teachers’ professional development.
the reform of physical education curriculum in China,and it is of significance for promoting the development of physical education and the improvement of students’ physical and mental health.

the development of school physical education and its reform, and the authors put forward the opinions and suggestions from the perspective of physical education teaching contents, teaching methods, teaching materials, etc.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

physical education teachers are the basic conditional resources of the reform of physical education curriculum,and the key to the development and utilization of the resources lies in the teachers themselves.
physical education curriculum reform is the reform of physical education teachers’ teaching contents and methods,as wellas reform of physical education curriculum resources.

school physical education reform should follow the principle of “combining the fitness nature with cultural features,selectivity with efficiency,national characteristics with international characteristics” to make a comprehensive reform of the teaching contents,teaching methods and teaching resources,so that physical education can play its role in promoting the all-round development of students.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have made a great deal of achievements in physical education curriculum research,but the problems that need to be solved are also many,and the key to solving the problems is to improve the quality of teaching and the level of teaching.

the reform of physical education curriculum should be carried out from three aspects: teaching contents, teaching methods and curriculum resources, and it should be based on the characteristics of physical education curriculum, the needs of students’ growth and development, and the actual situation of physical education teaching in China.
the curriculum reform of physical education should focus on the improvement of teaching quality,and the development of teaching materials should be the focus of curriculum reform.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the development of school physical education should be based on the characteristics of physical education curriculum,and the development of school curriculums should be based on physical education curriculum.

the physical education curriculum reform should follow the principles of combining fitness nature with culture nature,selectivity and effectiveness,and national characteristics with world characteristics,and should be implemented by combining the development of curriculum with the development of curriculum resoures and the development of teaching methods.
physical education curriculum should not only focus on the development of student’s physical quality,but also on their mental and moral development.
